sourceFile: 笔译参考书1-《理解当代中国 核心术语学习手册》.pdf
notes:
来源为扫描件 Windows OCR（仅中文引擎）。本块属第三部分「用典阐释」：奇数页 p151/p153/p155/p157 页眉为「用 典 阐 释」，偶数页 p152/p154/p156/p158 页眉为「第 三 部 分」（该部分偶数页的版式），八页同属第三部分，未越界。已比对相邻分块：classics-p143-150.txt 末条为「天下为公」（其项目符号译法行含 `tO put one's interests asidefor the common good`），classics-p159-166.txt 首页 p159 页眉仍是「用 典 阐 释」，故本块两端都不是部分边界。
抽取范围：只收「中文典故行 + 项目符号英文译法行」。紧随译法行之后的「出自/意为/参见…」中文出处解释、中文讲话引文，以及成段英文阐释（含其中习近平讲话英文引文），一律未收；页眉与页码残片（p151 `《 35`、p153 `| 37`、p154 `《 38`、p156 单独一行 `0`）亦未收。
[订正登记：页码 原样 → 订正（依据）]
1. p151 cn `夭 下 兴 亡 、 匹 夫 有 责` → `天下兴亡、匹夫有责`：`夭`→`天`（字形混淆；本页中文讲解引梁启超「天下兴亡，匹夫有责」，同页中文讲话引文作「天下兴亡、匹夫有责的爱国情怀」）。
2. p151 en `SurvivaI Of a nation is the responsibility of every individual.` → `Survival ...`：`SurvivaI`→`Survival`（l↔I 字形混淆；p152 阐释续段同句作 `survival`）。
3. p151 en 同上句：`Of`→`of`（句中小写被认成大写；p152 同句作 `of a nation`）。
4. p151 en `· tofulfill one's duties tO secure the future Of the nation` → `to fulfill one's duties to secure the future of the nation`：`tofulfill` 缺空格、`tO`→`to`、`Of`→`of`（依据：本页习近平讲话英文引文作 `fulfilling one's duties to secure the future of the nation`）。
5. p152 en `· Just heaven maintains vigor through movement, a gentleman makes un remitting efforts tO perfect himself.` → `... makes unremitting efforts to perfect himself.`：`un remitting` 单词被拆、`tO`→`to`（依据：p153 英文引文作 `makes unremitting efforts tO perfect himself`，本页中文引文亦作「自强不息」）。
6. p153 en（为世用者条译法）`Writings, if useful tO society, are never enough ... one single page is far t00 many.` → `useful to society`、`far too many`：`tO`→`to`、`t00`→`too`（0↔o 字形混淆，`far too many` 为固定搭配）。
7. p154 en `· governance by means ofvirtue` → `governance by means of virtue`：`ofvirtue` 缺空格。
8. p154 en `tO uphold integrity and clear governance` → `to uphold integrity and clear governance`：`tO`→`to`（O/o 混淆）。
9. p155 en `· Conform ing tO the will of the people is the keytO governance.` → `Conforming to the will of the people is the key to governance.`：`Conform ing` 单词被拆、`keytO` 缺空格且 O/o 混淆（依据：本页习近平讲话英文引文作 `Conforming tO the will of the people is the key t0 governance`）。
10. p155 en `Practice improves understanding and a deeper understandi ng guides fu rther practice.` → `... a deeper understanding guides further practice.`：`understandi ng`、`fu rther` 单词被拆（依据：p156 英文引文同句作 `a deeper understanding guides further practice`）。
11. p156 en `。 toallow the natural ecosystems tO recover and regenerate themselves` → `to allow the natural ecosystems to recover and regenerate themselves`：`toallow` 缺空格、`tO`→`to`（依据：p157 英文引文作 `allow the natural ecosystems tO recover and regenerate themselves`）。
12. p156 en `· tO develop economy and increase population` → `to develop economy and increase population`：`tO`→`to`。
13. p156 en `。 tO recover from a SOCia 《 upheava 《 and restore production` → `to recover from a social upheaval and restore production`：`tO`→`to`、`SOCia 《`→`social`、`upheava 《`→`upheaval`（行末字母 l 被认成《；`social upheaval` 为固定搭配）。
14. p157 en `tO instruct someone through words and actions` → `to instruct someone through words and actions`：`tO`→`to`（依据：p158 英文引文作 `instruct them through words and actions`）。
合计 14 行登记、23 处具体订正（p158「宜将剩勇追穷寇，不可沽名学霸王」条译法 OCR 无误，未订正）。
存疑（配对）：2 处，均为「项目符号区内的短语式译法行」，不是中英对不上，而是怀疑其来源为讲话语境译法：
存疑（配对）①：p151「天下兴亡、匹夫有责」第二条译法 `to fulfill one's duties to secure the future of the nation` 首字母小写，且与本页习近平讲话英文引文中的从句 `fulfilling one's duties to secure the future of the nation` 几乎相同，疑为讲话语境下的对应译法而非独立条目译法；因该行位于本条的项目符号区内，按「多条译法全部收进 en 数组」保留，请复核是否应与第一条合并或剔除。
存疑（配对）②：p154「为政以德」第三条项目符号行 `to uphold integrity and clear governance`（OCR 丢失项目符号）同样以 `tO` 小写起首，与本页讲话引文 `tO honor one's reputation and uphOld integrity and clean government` 对应，且与本套书他处（classics-p143-150.txt「天下为公」条 `tO put one's interests asidefor the common good`）的写法一致，故判为原书所列的又一条译法予以保留，但配对把握中等。
未收内容提示（请勿当成漏收）：p151 第 3–18 行成段英文是上一条（p150「天下为公」）的阐释及其习近平讲话引文；p151 第 33–38 行、p152 第 42–57 行、p153 第 79–86 行、p153 第 95–105 行、p154 第 119–122 行、p154 第 141–150 行、p155 第 154–156 行、p155 第 165–175 行、p156 第 189–202 行、p157 第 229–233 行、p157 第 244–256 行、p158 第 265–281 行、p158 第 294–299 行等成段英文，分别是「天下兴亡、匹夫有责」「天行健，君子以自强不息」「天行有常」「为世用者…」「为政以德」「为政之要…」「行之力…」「休养生息」「学如弓弩…」「言传身教」「宜将剩勇…」各条的中文出处解释、中文讲话引文或英文阐释，按规则 1、3 不予收录（其中的 OCR 错误因属阐释文本，不计入订正登记）。

en: Survival of a nation is the responsibility of every individual.
to fulfill one's duties to secure the future of the nation

entries.cn: 天行健，君子以自强不息。
en: Just heaven maintains vigor through movement, a gentleman makes unremitting efforts to perfect himself.

entries.cn: 为世用者，百篇无害；不为用者，一章无补。
en: Writings, if useful to society, are never enough even if there are more than a hundred of them; while if useless, one single page is far too many.
to uphold integrity and clear governance

entries.cn: 为政之要，以顺民心为本。
en: Conforming to the will of the people is the key to governance.

entries.cn: 行之力则知愈进，知之深则行愈达。
en: Practice improves understanding and a deeper understanding guides further practice.
to allow the natural ecosystems to recover and regenerate themselves
to develop economy and increase population
to recover from a social upheaval and restore production
Learning is the bow, while competence is the arrow.
to instruct someone through words and actions

entries.cn: 宜将剩勇追穷寇，不可沽名学霸王。
en: One should chase down the last remnant of the enemy till the whole land was liberated, rather than giving up halfway.
